digest.component_or_area: CI lint gate / script tooling quality
propositions: scripts/ directory (41 files) is currently excluded from lint and typecheck gates and contains 78 ruff violations (50 T201 print + 12 RUF100 unused-noqa + 11 E501 line-too-long + 2 RUF005 + 2 RUF059 + 1 B905 + 1 RUF036), and 7 files require reformatting by ruff format

Seven CI-invoked gate scripts (check_verify_gate_parity, check_comment_hygiene, check_raw_git_writes, check_wall_clock_asserts, gen_env_registry, check_docs_index, check_readme_quickstart) are themselves ungated and their implementations contain linting violations despite being blocking workflow checks

T201 exemptions are currently scattered across nine separate per-file-ignores entries in pyproject.toml for individual scripts, and 28 redundant inline noqa directives exist across 13 files that will become new RUF100 violations if consolidated
Five RUF100 directives reference disabled rules (PLC0415, S603, S310, PLR0915) with live rationale that must be confirmed as intents before deletion

The 28 substantive violations (excluding T201) have no live defects: RUF100 are dead directives, E501 requires only rewrap, RUF005 and RUF059 require minor refactoring, B905 at check_wall_clock_asserts.py:101 is construction-guaranteed safe
